decisions.reason: After two years the low-pile carpet still costs little to hold in a premium collection, and there is no signal that its value will not materialize, so the option stays open.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet reinforces the craftsmanship positioning at low holding cost, so keeping it while demand evidence accumulates is justified.
This decorative carpet overlaps with other rugs, which raises the chance of pruning in a collection refresh, but its low keeping cost still favors holding the option.
The corner bench extends the established upholstery and dining offer for residential and hospitality projects, and its continued presence supports further commitment.
With minimal holding costs within a broad portfolio and no negative signals, abandoning the low-pile carpet now would destroy option value prematurely.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line serves contract and residential markets, and its sustained presence suggests its value is being realized.
